legend-pikes-peak-highway.slogan: Pikes Peak Highway – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-pikes-peak-highway.story: curated scenic road. high alpine, summit road, Front Range views. 17 km from Manitou Springs to Manitou Springs, about 19 min of riding. It goes by way of Cascade-Chipita Park and Woodland Park. The highest point is about 3,900 m. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Pikes Peak Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 5 km this is Pikes Peak Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
